title: Relative versus absolute RNA quantification in endothelial expression of vasoactive receptors
author: Kuhlmann, Cieselski, et al.

steps.title: Culture endothelial cells
steps.instruction: Grow endothelial cells at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ in a humidified incubator using basal microvascular endothelial growth medium supplemented with 5 ng ml⁻¹ VEGF, 5 ng ml⁻¹ EGF, 5 ng ml⁻¹ FGF, 15 ng ml⁻¹ IGF‑1, 10 mM L‑glutamine, 0.75 U ml⁻¹ heparin sulfate, 1 µg ml⁻¹ hydrocortisone hemisuccinate, 50 µg ml⁻¹ ascorbic acid, 5 % v/v FCS, and 12.5 µg ml⁻¹ blasticidin (Provitro, Berlin, Germany).

steps.title: Cytokine stimulation
steps.instruction: Replace the growth medium with supplement‑free basal medium and incubate for 24 h; then add IL‑1β, TNF‑α, and IFN‑γ (PeproTech, Hamburg, Germany) each at 100 ng ml⁻¹ and incubate for an additional 24 h.

steps.title: Extract total RNA
steps.instruction: Isolate total RNA using the InviTrap Spin Cell RNA Mini kit (Stratec Biomedical AG, Birkenfeld, Germany), measure concentration and purity with a NanoVue spectrophotometer (GE Healthcare, Solingen, Germany), and treat the eluate with DNAse I (2000 U ml⁻¹; New England Biolabs, Frankfurt (Main), Germany) according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Synthesize cDNA
steps.instruction: Generate cDNA from the DNase‑treated RNA using qScript cDNA SuperMix (Quanta Biosciences, Gaithersburg, USA) following the supplier’s instructions, and prepare a no‑reverse‑transcriptase control by using heat‑inactivated qScript SuperMix for each sample.

steps.title: Statistical analysis of data
steps.instruction: Perform qPCR in 5 independent experiments with 9 technical replicates each and ddPCR in 5 independent experiments with 3 technical replicates each; analyze results with a paired parametric two‑sided t‑test using GraphPad Prism 6 (GraphPad Software, La Jolla, USA), considering p < 0.05 as significant.
